⚖️I’m delighted to share that my article, “The Misuse of Criminal Law as a Tool to Silence Dissent: An Article 19 Perspective,” has been published on Law Jurist

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to my Media Law faculty for providing me with this valuable opportunity to explore such an important constitutional issue.

Looking forward to more opportunities in legal research and writing! 📚✨

#LawJurist #LegalResearch #Article19 #CriminalLaw #ConstitutionalLaw #LegalPublication
comment: The real test often lies in how necessity and proportionality are assessed at the point of arrest. Early procedural safeguards can make the difference between legitimate prosecution and the chilling of lawful dissent.
